name: md-organizer
description: Self-hosted, distraction-free digital library and web reader for Markdown books and documentation with version control.

scripts.seed: node -e "const { processZipFile } = require('./src/processor'); const path = require('path'); (async () => { await processZipFile(path.join('examples', '1_libro_codigo_limpio_v1.zip'), '1_libro_codigo_limpio_v1.zip'); await processZipFile(path.join('examples', '4_sqlite_guia_auto.zip'), '4_sqlite_guia_auto.zip'); await processZipFile(path.join('examples', '5_especificacion_mdz_book.mdz'), '5_especificacion_mdz_book.mdz'); console.log('📚 Biblioteca inicializada con libros de ejemplo (.zip y .mdz).'); })();"

author: Ramón Menor
